item.title: Building an Email Priority Classifier
item.description: I’ve always wondered: what actually makes an email urgent? Is it the length? The words? The tone? So I built TriageAI - a model that classifies incoming emails into priority levels (Urgent, High, Medium, Low) to figure out what deserves attention right now.
